title: audit-point-022
goal: Learn a reusable expert skill for finding and writing one professional internal audit opinion: 购买 1 个月设备是否调整重置全价. The final blank agent should produce exactly one audit opinion item, not a full report.

initialGraph.planner_summary: Single-point audit learnbench: inspect all shared valuation materials, learn one reusable audit finding pattern, and write a one-point audit output for soft validation.

units.title: Inspect Shared Materials
units.goal: Inspect the shared valuation report and working papers for evidence related to this audit finding type: 检查购买时间距离评估基准日很近的设备，是否仍需要进行 PPI 或重置全价调整。 Do not write a full audit report.
units.claim: Relevant evidence and checking targets for this one audit issue type have been identified.
units.check_plan: Write concise material notes with exact pages, sheets, rows, cells, or report sections where possible.

units.title: Write Single Point Skill And Output
units.goal: Create a reusable skill package that teaches the finding pattern, and write workspace/audit-point-output.md containing exactly one professional audit opinion item.
units.claim: The skill and one-point audit output are complete.
units.check_plan: The output must be one actionable audit opinion item with evidence, issue, and requested correction/check.

notes: One instance learns exactly one audit finding pattern. Shared material directories are visible read-only inputs; do not copy or edit them. The answer file is used only by the soft validator.
